text: As soon as she saw him she uttered a little cry, almost of terror. “How can you frighten me so?” she exclaimed, with a flushed face. “It is past ten o’clock, and you have no right to surprise me here at such a time.” “I don’t know that I’ve not the right. At any rate I have the excuse. Is it so necessary that I should stop to think of manners and customs?” “It is too late for propriety, and might injure me.” “I called an hour ago, and you would not see me, and I thought you were in when I called now.
